limitations.note: The patch correctly clocked the counter but also removed the existing `ready_b` condition, so an accepted first input overwrites `data_out` when `ready_b` is low instead of adding to it as the reference does.

The scoreboard assumed each group starts a fresh sum regardless of `ready_b` and checked data only when an output was pending, so its passing result did not establish that the patch preserved the original accumulation behavior.
The Git check had to be replaced with direct file inspection, and an earlier chained directory listing likewise failed and forced a separate Icarus check.
